contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]TANTI VS PF [AVG] ; R/ [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]TANTI VS PF [AVG]. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths aloft. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]. Diameter: 14.6mm, Weight: 1.28gms, die axis: 6
